semantics: Horizontal dry paving plus horizontal cream/gold perimeter curb through its outer edge. Exclude shaded vertical fascia, underlying arches, sky and scenery. No convex hull. No modification or inference within the cloud-hole edit mask.
measurement: Manual native-size and 3x/8x crop review of all fourteen corners and edges; constrained directional pixel-gradient measurements corroborate visible top-face transitions. Use half-pixel edge locations between adjacent pixel centers. Straight 14-segment approximation; not semantic segmentation.
integration_scope: Read-only recommendation. No repository, geometry, physics, anchor, wind, source image or hole changes performed.
